solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Citizen's "thing" about new copper by entrance to nick

indicators.note: about says the word for thing goes around the new copper pieces

parts.note: a 'thing' about something is an obsession, a mania
Cu is the chemical symbol for copper

indicators.note: entrance to means the opening letter of the word nick

explanation.surface: A citizen with an obsession about a new policeman arriving at the entrance to the police station.
explanation.walkthrough: Manchester City football club's fans are nicknamed the Citizens, so a Citizen's thing is a Manchester one; the surface's citizen is just anyone.
explanation.definitionFit: Manchester City are nicknamed the Citizens, so belonging to a Citizen means belonging to Manchester, the adjective for that city.

clue.text: Muslim legal expert in plain clothes

definitions.meaning: a scholar who gives rulings on Islamic law
civilian dress worn by someone normally in uniform

explanation.surface: A specialist in Islamic law going about out of uniform.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an Islamic jurist and, from British army slang, civilian clothes worn off duty.

clue.text: No-hoper's note about first of songs in Evita

parts.note: on means about, concerning

indicators.note: in says the first letter of songs goes inside the surname of Evita

parts.note: Evita was Eva Perón, wife of the Argentine president

indicators.note: first of means the opening letter of the word songs

explanation.surface: A loser hums a note while thinking of the first number in the musical Evita.
explanation.walkthrough: Evita here is the person, Eva Perón, giving PERON, not the musical the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone treated as a nobody, of no account, is a person with no hope of mattering.

clue.text: Ignorant over revolutionary crushed by a French king

indicators.note: in a down clue, being crushed by something means sitting beneath it

parts.note: un is French for a
Tut is short for Tutankhamun, the boy king of Egypt
O is the cricket abbreviation for an over
a red is a revolutionary, a communist

explanation.surface: An ignorant figure, once a radical, is overwhelmed by a French monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: 'crushed by' means the O and RED come under UN and TUT in this down entry.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who has never been taught or schooled is ignorant, lacking instruction.

clue.text: Possible theatre pieces culminate in disc for distribution

indicators.note: letters put out for distribution are spread about and rearranged

explanation.surface: Theatre pieces end up on a recording sold to the public.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for distribution' rearranges the fifteen letters of CULMINATE IN DISC.
explanation.definitionFit: Music written to accompany a play is played in the theatre, so such scores are possible examples of theatre pieces.

clue.text: Modern Glaswegian woman with a way round northern police HQ

parts.note: new means modern
someone from Glasgow is a Scot

indicators.note: round says the pieces for woman, a and way go around the letter for northern

parts.note: a lady is a woman
RD is the abbreviation for road, a way

explanation.surface: A modern woman from Glasgow travels a road round the north towards police headquarters.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' wraps the woman, a and way around the northern letter. This is the headquarters of London's Metropolitan Police.
explanation.definitionFit: This is the name of the London headquarters building of the Metropolitan Police.

clue.text: Victorious boxer, say, taking tea with elected member

parts.note: cha is a British slang word for tea
MP is a Member of Parliament, an elected member

explanation.surface: A winning boxer takes tea with the local MP.
explanation.definitionFit: A title-holder or winner of a fight is a champion, here in its informal short form.

clue.text: Make progress as Conservative member

parts.note: a limb is a member of the body, an arm or leg

explanation.surface: Someone advances as a Tory party member.
explanation.definitionFit: To rise in rank or status, ascending a ladder, is to make progress.

clue.text: Highest grade of hotel in mountain area

indicators.note: in puts the letter for hotel inside the pieces for mountain and area

parts.note: an alp is a high mountain
H is hotel in the NATO phonetic alphabet

explanation.surface: A top-rated hotel up in the mountains.
explanation.definitionFit: The first letter of the Greek alphabet marks the top mark in grading, as in an alpha for an essay.

clue.text: Capital fellow digesting notice, full of bliss

indicators.note: digesting says the capital takes the notice inside it

parts.note: Paris is the capital of France
an ad is a notice, an advertisement
Al is a man's name, any fellow

explanation.surface: A man from the capital takes in a notice and is blissfully happy.
explanation.definitionFit: Being like heaven or Eden means being full of bliss, heavenly.

clue.text: Cool off by upper room reportedly in buff?

parts.note: to fan someone is to cool them off

indicators.note: reportedly says we want how the word for an upper room sounds, not how it is spelt

parts.note: an attic is a room at the top of a house

explanation.surface: Someone cools off by the top-floor room, perhaps naked.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in buff' suggests nudity, but the definition is buff as an enthusiast.
explanation.definitionFit: A buff is a keen enthusiast, as in a film buff, the same as a zealot or devotee.

clue.text: Plaintive cry from male cat going about with queen

indicators.note: going about means the word for cat surrounds the letter for male

parts.note: the cat, cat-o'-nine-tails, is a whip
ER is Elizabeth Regina, the Queen

explanation.surface: A tomcat prowls around with a female cat, making a mournful noise.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface pictures tomcat and queen cats; here cat is the whip and queen is ER.
explanation.definitionFit: A soft, broken sound of distress or complaint is a plaintive cry.

clue.text: Incompetent people initially taken in at home and abroad

parts.note: in means at home

indicators.note: taken in says the first letter of people goes inside the foreign and

parts.note: et is French, a foreign language, for and

indicators.note: initially means the first letter of the word people

explanation.surface: Bungling people are welcomed both at home and overseas.
explanation.definitionFit: Clumsy and lacking skill, someone incompetent is inept.

clue.text: Dodge bloke carrying extremely angular wooden slat

parts.note: to duck is to dodge

indicators.note: carrying says the word for bloke holds the outer letters of angular

parts.note: bod is British slang for a person, a bloke

indicators.note: extremely means the letters at the ends of the word angular

explanation.surface: A bony man dodges while carrying a piece of timber.
explanation.definitionFit: A path of wooden slats laid over mud is made of these slats, each one a board.

clue.text: Justification for reversing, avoiding a head wind

indicators.note: avoiding means the letter A is left out
reversing means the word for justification is read backwards

parts.note: a reason is a justification

explanation.surface: A driver gives an excuse for backing up, sidestepping a strong gust in the face.
explanation.walkthrough: 'for reversing' reverses REASON to NOSAER; 'avoiding a' drops its A.
explanation.definitionFit: Sailors call a wind blowing straight into the bows a noser, a strong head wind.

clue.text: Bloke in gym upset over recent form of identification

indicators.note: in a down clue upset means turned upside down, so the letters read backwards

parts.note: PE is physical education, gym lessons
a man is a bloke
late can mean recent, as in the late news

explanation.surface: A man at the gym is annoyed about a new kind of ID.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns PE plus MAN into NAMEP, with LATE below it.
explanation.definitionFit: A small plaque with a person's name on a door identifies who is there.

clue.text: Ill-famed old port toured by other people?

indicators.note: toured by says the phrase for other people goes all round the pieces for old and port

parts.note: other people are not us
Rio de Janeiro is a Brazilian port

explanation.surface: A disreputable old harbour visited by outsiders.
explanation.definitionFit: Being widely known for something bad means having an evil reputation, being ill-famed.

clue.text: Storyteller's regret about supporting crook in desert

indicators.note: in a down clue, supporting means sitting underneath
in puts the word for crook inside the word for desert

parts.note: to rat on someone is to desert them
a con is a criminal, a crook

indicators.note: about means the word for regret is turned round

parts.note: to rue something is to regret it

explanation.surface: A storyteller regrets helping a criminal in the desert.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' turns the regret word round; 'supporting' sets it beneath the crook-in-desert piece in this down entry. Desert is the verb, to abandon, not sand.
explanation.definitionFit: A skilled teller of anecdotes is a storyteller.

clue.text: Big tool a builder originally contrived for important bit of work

indicators.note: contrived means put together artificially, so the letters are rearranged
originally means the first letter of the word builder

explanation.surface: A builder rigged up a large tool for a key piece of the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'contrived' rearranges BIGTOOLA plus B, the first letter of builder.
explanation.definitionFit: In music an obbligato is an accompanying instrumental part that must not be left out, an essential part of the work.

clue.text: Lack of spirit in second author's first stage piece

indicators.note: in says the lack of spirit goes inside the pieces for second and author's first

parts.note: mo is short for moment, a second

indicators.note: first means the opening letter of the word author's

parts.note: no means a lack of, as in no money
a dram is a tot of spirit, usually whisky

explanation.surface: An author's debut play shows no spark in its second act.
explanation.walkthrough: A spirit here is a drink, giving NO DRAM, not dullness as the surface suggests.
explanation.definitionFit: A play for a single performer is a kind of stage piece.

clue.text: Some retired fella backing a conspiratorial group

indicators.note: retired says the hidden letters are read backwards
Some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Some retired man is backing a group of plotters.
explanation.definitionFit: A small secret faction plotting together, a junta or clique, is a conspiratorial group.

clue.text: Played for each class — Elgar and Delius to begin with

parts.note: per means for each, as in per person
a form is a class in a British school

indicators.note: to begin with means the first letters of the words Elgar and Delius

explanation.surface: Each class played pieces by Elgar and Delius, the English composers, to start.
explanation.definitionFit: Music that was played was performed, executed before an audience.

clue.text: Charge pounds to see musteline mammal

parts.note: a rate is a charge, a price
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from Latin libra

explanation.surface: Pay a fee to see a weasel-like animal at the zoo.
explanation.definitionFit: The honey badger of Africa and Asia belongs to the weasel family, the mustelids.

clue.text: Circuit minister finally overcome by memorial notice

indicators.note: overcome by says the last letter of minister goes inside the notice word

parts.note: an obit is an obituary, a notice in memory of the dead

indicators.note: finally means the last letter of the word minister

explanation.surface: A minister on his round is finally overcome by a death notice.
explanation.definitionFit: A path traced round a planet, a full revolution, is a circuit.

clue.text: Semi-divine spirit heard near a pond ultimately

indicators.note: heard says we want the sound of the word for near, not its spelling

parts.note: nigh means near

indicators.note: ultimately means the last letter of the word pond

explanation.surface: A water spirit is heard close to a pond at last.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth a water nymph was a minor goddess, a semi-divine spirit of springs and streams.

clue.text: Fearfully anticipate being late securing runs

indicators.note: securing says the word for late holds the letter for runs

parts.note: the late means dead, as in the late king
R is the cricket abbreviation for runs

explanation.surface: A batsman fears being late, though securing some runs.
explanation.definitionFit: To dread something is to look forward to it with fear.

clue.text: Resort where I live surrounded by workers

indicators.note: surrounded by says the word for workers goes round I and the word for live

parts.note: worker ants are the classic crossword workers
to be is to live, to exist

explanation.surface: Someone describes the holiday town where they live among working people.
explanation.definitionFit: This town on the French Riviera is a well-known seaside resort.

clue.text: Demonstration disc found in a church gallery

parts.note: CE is the Church of England
the Tate is a famous London art gallery

explanation.surface: A demo record is discovered in a church art gallery.
explanation.definitionFit: Demo recordings were cut onto discs coated in this plastic, a one-off lacquer disc.

clue.text: Social distinction of Liberal entertained by English queen, perhaps

indicators.note: entertained by says the cat word holds the letter for Liberal

parts.note: a queen is a female cat, so a queen is an example of a cat

explanation.surface: A Liberal politician gains prestige by being entertained by an English monarch.
explanation.walkthrough: Queen here is a female cat, not a monarch; 'perhaps' marks it as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: Brilliant success or acclaim, bringing prestige, is a mark of social distinction.

clue.text: Furniture-maker finding love in a crowded complex

indicators.note: in puts the letter for love inside the rearranged letters
complex means intricate, tangled, so the letters are rearranged

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, so the letter O

explanation.surface: A furniture-maker falls in love in a busy building complex.
explanation.walkthrough: 'complex' rearranges A CROWDED into CEDARWOD, and 'in' puts O inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The timber of the cedar tree is a material from which furniture is made.
